technical-summary: moe-remote protocol v25: request slot = (helper, consumer rank); helpers compute routed experts full-width once and the consumer rank of a layer (layer % world) adds them, so a TP engine sums each helper row exactly once; N helpers behind M engine ranks; per-consumer combine; live placement behind TP. Derived helper budgets subtract the helper's own lane/bank footprint (worker_footprint.h shared by worker and bc-serve, incl. power save and small-lane classes). libr3 engine takes R3_MOE_NATIVE/FP16/AHALF default on when unset. Lab layout flashnext-tp2xtx (2x gfx1100 TP, R9700 head + 6900 XT tail). One-rank path verified neutral on flashnext-4gpu (same-session A/B).
user-summary-candidate: Flash-Next can now run tensor-parallel on the two 7900 XTX with the R9700 and RX 6900 XT holding experts (lab layouts); helper experts are computed once instead of once per rank.
